answer.origin: Yahoo Finance reported an announcement by NN, Inc. made in late June 2026; the exact announcement date is not stated. The article was published July 1, 2026.
answer.note: NN reportedly announced 47 additional machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid-cooling production intended for NVIDIA AI data-center racks (incoming). NN also reportedly said all of this new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (item:e2), and targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion (item:e3). This is supplier-side evidence of planned, reportedly allocated capacity relevant to NVIDIA-linked rack supply. It does not establish that NVIDIA is the customer, that NVIDIA placed an order, or that the target represents NVIDIA revenue. Those stronger links remain hypotheses: the article does not identify award customers or explain the supply-chain connection, so all the reported facts could be true without NVIDIA directly buying from NN. If the awards serve NVIDIA-bound systems and the capacity is installed and ramped as planned, the expansion could support availability of liquid-cooling components for those systems.
limitations: The article does not identify the award customers, their positions in the supply chain, or what share of the pre-sold capacity is for NVIDIA-bound systems.

It gives no capacity volume, installation or ramp schedule, contract value, delivery terms, or realized revenue; the US$80–US$90 million figure is NN's 2026 target, not a reported result or an NVIDIA order.
The exact date of NN's announcement is not provided, and the supplied material does not include the original announcement for independent verification.
follow_up: Check NN's original late-June announcement and subsequent filings for the capacity schedule, award terms, customer or end-market allocation, and whether the 2026 new-business target is achieved.

Look for company disclosures or other reliable supply-chain evidence identifying whether NN or its award customers supply NVIDIA-bound racks, and whether NVIDIA has disclosed any direct orders or relationship with NN.
